ex.en: The company registered its trademark in more than twenty countries last year.
ex.zh: 该公司去年在二十多个国家注册了商标。

words.note: trademark 指注册商标；brand 侧重品牌形象。

ex.en: Cost was the main factor in our decision to postpone the project.
ex.zh: 成本是我们决定推迟该项目的主要因素。

words.note: factor 后常接 in，说明在哪方面是因素。

ex.en: The structure of an atom is often said to be analogous to a tiny solar system.
ex.zh: 原子的结构常被说成类似一个微型太阳系。

words.note: analogous 固定接 to，不接 with；名词是 analogy。

ex.en: Scientists found a harmful substance in the water supply of the village.
ex.zh: 科学家在村里的供水中发现了一种有害物质。

words.note: substance 指具体物质，抽象义常见于 in substance。

ex.en: Her fair complexion makes bright colors look especially good on her.
ex.zh: 她白皙的肤色使亮色衣服穿在她身上特别好看。

words.note: complexion 指天生肤色，也可引申指局面性质。

ex.en: The new manager tried to maintain continuity in the team's daily routine.
ex.zh: 新经理努力保持团队日常工作的连续性。

words.note: continuity 来自 continuous，指时间上不中断。

ex.en: The museum has a fine collection of modern sculpture from Europe.
ex.zh: 这家博物馆收藏了一批精美的欧洲现代雕塑。

words.note: sculpture 不可数指雕塑艺术，可数指一件作品。

ex.en: Sales this quarter failed to meet the target set by the head office.
ex.zh: 本季度销售额未达到总部设定的目标。

words.note: target 后常接 for，如 a target for next year。

ex.en: The campaign gained momentum after several famous writers voiced support.
ex.zh: 几位知名作家表示支持后，这场运动势头渐强。

words.note: momentum 常与 gain、lose、build 搭配，指发展势头。

ex.en: The museum is famous for its lifelike wax figures of famous people.
ex.zh: 这家博物馆以名人逼真的蜡像闻名。

words.note: wax 作名词指蜡，作动词指上蜡；蜡像馆为 wax museum。

ex.en: Her first novel caused a sensation and was soon translated into ten languages.
ex.zh: 她的第一部小说引起轰动，很快被译成十种语言。

words.note: sensation 既指身体感觉，也指轰动一时的人或事。

ex.en: More and more young people are moving to urban areas in search of work.
ex.zh: 越来越多年轻人迁往城市地区找工作。

words.note: urban 与 rural 相对；动词 urbanize 指使城市化。

ex.en: The plan is too expensive; furthermore, it would take years to complete.
ex.zh: 该计划花费太高，而且还要多年才能完成。

words.note: furthermore 是正式书面连接词，用于补充论点。

ex.en: The doctor's timely intervention saved the patient's life.
ex.zh: 医生及时的干预挽救了病人的生命。

words.note: timely 作定语表及时的；in time 表及时地。

ex.en: The superhero wore a long red cape that fluttered in the wind.
ex.zh: 那位超级英雄披着在风中飘动的红色长斗篷。

words.note: cape 指无袖斗篷，也指伸入海中的海角。

ex.en: Please discard any documents that are no longer needed for the audit.
ex.zh: 请丢弃审计不再需要的任何文件。

words.note: discard 强调当作无用之物扔掉，比 throw away 正式。

ex.en: The two sides have reached a delicate balance after months of talks.
ex.zh: 经过数月谈判，双方达成了微妙的平衡。

words.note: delicate 可指易碎、纤细或微妙，如 delicate issue。

ex.en: Many teenagers rebel against their parents' strict rules at some point.
ex.zh: 许多青少年在某个阶段会反抗父母的严格规定。

words.note: rebel 后接 against；作名词指反叛者，重音在前。

ex.en: Farmers in the region receive a government subsidy for growing corn.
ex.zh: 该地区的农民种玉米可获得政府补贴。

words.note: subsidy 多指政府补贴，动词为 subsidize。

ex.en: The ball bounced off the wall and rolled across the floor.
ex.zh: 球从墙上弹开，滚过地板。

words.note: bounce back 除弹回外，常指受挫后迅速恢复。

ex.en: The film was banned in some countries for its obscene language.
ex.zh: 这部电影因语言下流在部分国家被禁。

words.note: obscene 除淫秽外，口语可指过分到令人反感的。

ex.en: The doctor examined a sample of muscle tissue under the microscope.
ex.zh: 医生在显微镜下检查了肌肉组织样本。

words.note: tissue 指生物组织，日常也指纸巾。

ex.en: The whole family gathers at Grandma's house for Thanksgiving every year.
ex.zh: 每年全家都到奶奶家过感恩节。

words.note: Thanksgiving 首字母大写，问候说 Happy Thanksgiving。

ex.en: Applicants must show a high level of proficiency in spoken English.
ex.zh: 申请者必须具备较高的英语口语水平。

words.note: proficiency 常接 in，表示某方面的熟练度。

ex.en: Despite his success, he remains modest about his own achievements.
ex.zh: 尽管取得成功，他对自己的成就仍很谦逊。

words.note: modest 除谦虚外还指数量适中，如 a modest price。

ex.en: The tall building casts a long shadow over the square in the afternoon.
ex.zh: 下午那栋高楼在广场上投下长长的阴影。

words.note: cast 的过去式和过去分词都是 cast。

ex.en: He chose vocational training instead of university and now runs a workshop.
ex.zh: 他选择职业培训而非上大学，如今经营一家车间。

words.note: vocational 来自 vocation，指技能型职业的。

ex.en: The government sent troops to crush the rebellion in the northern province.
ex.zh: 政府派兵镇压北部省份的叛乱。

words.note: crush 指压碎或彻底镇压；have a crush on 意为迷恋。

ex.en: Years of unfair treatment had filled the workers with hatred.
ex.zh: 多年的不公待遇使工人们心中充满仇恨。

words.note: hatred 后接 of、for 或 towards，是不可数名词。

ex.en: She cut herself a thick slice of bread and spread butter on it.
ex.zh: 她给自己切了一片厚面包，抹上黄油。

words.note: slice 作量词用 a slice of，作动词指切成薄片。
